grammar:
root ::= "{" ws "\"cypher\"" ws ":" ws "\"" query "\"" ws "}"

query ::= match_clause (ws match_clause)* (ws where_clause)? ws return_clause (ws order_clause)? ws limit_clause

match_clause ::= "MATCH " pattern
pattern ::= node (rel node)*
node ::= "(" var? label_part scope ")"
label_part ::= ":" label
scope ::= " {" wsp "_workspace_id" wsp ":" wsp "$workspace_id" wsp "}"
rel ::= arrow_l rel_detail arrow_r
arrow_l ::= "-" | "<-"
arrow_r ::= "->" | "-"
rel_detail ::= "[" var? ":" reltype hop_bound? "]"
hop_bound ::= "*1.." digit
digit ::= "1" | "2" | "3" | "4"

where_clause ::= "WHERE " predicate (" AND " predicate)*
predicate ::= ref ws comparator ws param
comparator ::= "=" | ">=" | "<=" | ">" | "<" | "<>"
param ::= "$channel_risk" | "$risk_tier" | "$acct_no" | "$amount" | "$limit" | "$ts" | "$a" | "$n"

return_clause ::= "RETURN " ret_item (", " ret_item)*
ret_item ::= (aggregate | ref | "DISTINCT " ref) (" AS " var)?
aggregate ::= agg_fn "(" ("DISTINCT " )? ref ")"
agg_fn ::= "collect" | "count" | "avg" | "max" | "min" | "sum"

order_clause ::= "ORDER BY " ref (" DESC" | " ASC")?
limit_clause ::= "LIMIT $limit"

ref ::= var ("." prop)?
label ::= "Account" | "Channel" | "Company" | "Medium" | "Person" | "Loan"
reltype ::= "USES_CHANNEL" | "GUARANTEE" | "TRANSFER" | "WITHDRAW" | "DEPOSIT" | "SIGN_IN" | "INVEST" | "APPLY" | "REPAY" | "OWN"
prop ::= "_workspace_id" | "channel_risk" | "cross_border" | "risk_weight" | "risk_level" | "acct_type" | "principal" | "risk_tier" | "tx_count" | "acct_no" | "channel" | "country" | "flagged" | "amount" | "sector" | "label" | "limit" | "code" | "iban" | "name" | "type" | "id" | "ts"
var ::= [a-z] [a-z0-9_]*
ws ::= " "*
wsp ::= " "*

samples.cypher: MATCH (a:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:TRANSFER]->(t:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id }) WHERE t.acct_no = $acct_no RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:TRANSFER]->(t:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id }) WHERE t.acct_no = $acct_no RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:OWN]->(c:Company { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:TRANSFER*1..3]-(acc:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id }) WHERE acc.acct_no = $acct_no AND p.id = $n AND c.id = $acct_no RETURN count(DISTINCT acc) AS num_transfers, max(acc.amount) AS max_amount ORDER BY num_transfers DESC LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:OWN]->(c:Company { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:TRANSFER*1..3]-(acc:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id }) WHERE acc.acct_no = $acct_no AND p.id = $n AND c.id = $acct_no RETURN count(DISTINCT acc) AS num_transfers, max(acc.amount) AS max_amount ORDER BY num_transfers DESC LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:TRANSFER]->(t:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id }) WHERE t.acct_no = $acct_no AND t.channel_risk >= $limit RETURN a.id AS id, a.acct_no AS acct_no, a.iban AS iban, a.flagged AS flagged, a.risk_tier AS risk_tier, a.acct_type AS acct_type ORDER BY a.acct_no LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:TRANSFER]->(t:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id }) WHERE t.acct_no = $acct_no AND t.channel_risk >= $limit RETURN a.id AS id, a.acct_no AS acct_no, a.iban AS iban, a.flagged AS flagged, a.risk_tier AS risk_tier, a.acct_type AS acct_type ORDER BY a.acct_no LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:OWN]->(acc:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id }) WHERE acc.acct_no = $acct_no AND p.id = $n RETURN count(DISTINCT acc) AS num_accounts, sum(acc.amount) AS total_amount, avg(acc.amount) AS average_amount, max(acc.amount) AS maximum_amount, min(acc.amount) AS minimum_amount ORDER BY num_accounts DESC LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person { _workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[:OWN]->(acc:Account { _workspace_id: $workspace_id }) WHERE acc.acct_no = $acct_no AND p.id = $n RETURN count(DISTINCT acc) AS num_accounts, sum(acc.amount) AS total_amount, avg(acc.amount) AS average_amount, max(acc.amount) AS maximum_amount, min(acc.amount) AS minimum_amount ORDER BY num_accounts DESC LIMIT $limit
